name: Monster Mountain MX Park
tracks_on_site: main national track (about 1.35 miles, Stairway to Heaven jump)

soil.notes: Riders and a directory agree on a red clay, sand and loam mix. A 2011 rider called it sand and red clay.

layout.notes: Mark Barnett-built national-style layout with 80+ ft of elevation change, big jumps and a long lap. Riders repeatedly rank it among the best tracks in the Southeast or the country.

conditions.dry: Prep is usually best in the morning (2011 rider).
conditions.wet: Tracks stay closed when too wet; riders report trips lost to rain. A nearby sandy track (Shorter MX) is suggested as a rain-day backup.
conditions.watering_prep: Riders describe consistently good prep, with heavy investment after a 2018 ownership change.
conditions.seasonal: Ride days posted on social media; historically most weekends spring-fall and daily over holidays and Feb-Mar. Weekday group training Mon-Thu. Hosts Loretta Lynn area qualifiers and AHRMA vintage.

rider_reports.says: Riders say it is a sand and red clay mix with a huge, long track, big jumps and lots of elevation; prep usually good, especially mornings.
Riders say new owners put money and effort in and it looked really good; one calls it among the best in the Southeast if not the nation.
Rider made three trips but only rode once because of rain; others call it the best track around and worth a long drive.
Georgia riders say Monster takes it over any Georgia track and is worth two extra hours of driving.
Rider says it now opens some weekdays and is worth any drive.
Visitors from the Northeast highly recommend it for winter riding.
